review: 716.3-1: the opponents_land variant changed three facts (active player, who plays a land, which land); replaced it with the one-fact change that B controls Druid Class, and dropped the now unused Mountain.

scenarios.title: A level bar is activatable only at sorcery speed and only when the Class is one level below

setup.notes: Druid Class is level 1. Its bars: {2}{G}: Level 2 (additional land each turn); {4}{G}: Level 3.

decisions: A activates the Level 2 ability of Druid Class, tapping three Forests.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: level_two_at_sorcery_speed
variants.expected: Legal: Druid Class is level 1 and it is A's main phase with an empty stack. The ability resolves and Druid Class becomes level 2.

variants.label: instant_timing
variants.delta: It is B's upkeep (B is the active player) and A has priority.
variants.expected: Not legal: a level bar can be activated only as a sorcery.

variants.label: already_level_two
variants.expected: Not legal: the Level 2 bar requires the Class to be level 1.

variants.label: skipping_a_level
variants.delta: A attempts the Level 3 ability ({4}{G}, tapping all five Forests) while Druid Class is level 1.
variants.expected: Not legal: the Level 3 bar requires the Class to be level 2.

scenarios.title: A level's static ability applies as long as the Class is at least that level

setup.notes: A has already played a land this turn (the Forest on the battlefield). Druid Class is level 2: its Level 2 text lets A play an additional land each turn. Druid Class's landfall trigger also gains A 1 life per land.

decisions: A attempts to play the Forest from hand as a second land this turn.

variants.label: level_two
variants.expected: Legal: the Class is level 2, so it has the ability to play an additional land each turn. The Forest enters and the landfall trigger gains A 1 life (21).

variants.label: level_one
variants.expected: Not legal: the Level 2 ability is not yet active and A has no land plays left.

scenarios.title: A copy of a Class does not copy its level; a permanent without a level is treated as level 1

setup.notes: The original Druid Class is level 2. Mirrormade enters as a copy of any artifact or enchantment.

decisions: A casts Mirrormade (tapping three Islands); it resolves and A has it enter as a copy of Druid Class.
A activates the Level 2 ability of the copy, tapping three Forests.

variants.label: activate_the_copy
variants.expected: Legal: the copy has no level (levels are not copiable) and is treated as level 1, so its Level 2 bar can be activated. It resolves and the copy becomes level 2. The original stays level 2.

variants.label: activate_the_original
variants.delta: A activates the Level 2 ability of the original Druid Class instead of the copy's.
variants.expected: Not legal: the original is level 2 and the Level 2 bar requires level 1.

scenarios.forge_notes: The part of 716.2b about a permanent that stops being a Class keeping its level is not illustrated: no Forge card removes the Class type from a Class.

scenarios.title: A Class's ability not preceded by a level bar works at every level

setup.notes: Druid Class is level 1. Its top section is 'Landfall - whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life.'

decisions: The landfall trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: level_one
variants.expected: The landfall trigger fires although Druid Class is only level 1; A gains 1 life (21).

variants.label: level_two
variants.expected: The landfall trigger fires the same way; A gains 1 life (21).

variants.label: opponent_controls_class
variants.delta: Druid Class is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: The Forest enters under A's control, not under the Class controller's, so the landfall trigger does not fire. A and B stay at 20 life.

scenarios.title: Level counters and class levels do not interact

setup.notes: Druid Class is level 1. Student of Warfare is a leveler: 2 or more level counters make it a 3/3 with first strike. Venerated Teacher puts two level counters on each creature its controller has with level up.

decisions: A casts Venerated Teacher, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; it resolves and enters. Its enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: class_level_one
variants.expected: Student of Warfare gets 2 level counters and becomes a 3/3 with first strike. Druid Class gets no level counters (it has no level up) and stays at class level 1.

variants.label: class_level_three
variants.expected: Student of Warfare still gets exactly 2 level counters and becomes a 3/3 with first strike, not a higher level: Druid Class's class level plays no part. Druid Class gets no level counters and stays at class level 3.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge needs the Class level to be set directly in the setup.
